name: blueprint/image-pipeline
description: Image transforms as a pipeline: ffmpeg/ImageMagick run the transform, exit 0 gates the publish, R2 stores, the presigned link ships
recipe: transform (resize, convert, strip) -> exit 0 means the file exists - gate the put -> publish and index -> share and notify
pitfalls: exit 0 gates the put - no empty uploads (artifact-publish)
contentType at put time or the browser renders it wrong
the presigned link expires - share then it is gone
